def.en: The regular shedding of the uterus lining, which leaves the body through the vagina as blood and tissue, usually for 2 to 7 days.
def.hg: Uterus ki lining ka regularly shed hona, jo blood aur tissue ke roop mein vagina ke raaste bahar aati hai, usually 2 se 7 din tak.

def.en: A muscular, pear-shaped organ in the lower abdomen whose lining builds up and sheds each cycle; a pregnancy grows here.
def.hg: Lower abdomen mein nashpati ki shape ka muscular organ, jiski lining har cycle mein banti aur shed hoti hai; pregnancy yahin grow karti hai.

def.en: The medical word for a person's very first period, which usually arrives between the ages of 10 and 15.
def.hg: Kisi ke sabse pehle period ke liye medical word, jo usually 10 se 15 saal ki age ke beech aata hai.

def.en: The repeating pattern counted from the first day of one period to the day before the next, typically 21 to 35 days in adults.
def.hg: Ek period ke first day se agle period se ek din pehle tak gina jaane wala repeating pattern, adults mein usually 21 se 35 din ka.

def.en: An absorbent strip worn inside the underwear to soak up menstrual blood, changed about every 4 to 6 hours.
def.hg: Absorbent strip jo period blood soak karne ke liye underwear ke andar lagayi jaati hai aur lagbhag har 4 se 6 ghante mein change ki jaati hai.

def.en: Clear or white fluid from the vagina that keeps it clean and moist; its texture changes through the cycle.
def.hg: Vagina se nikalne wala clear ya white fluid, jo use clean aur moist rakhta hai; cycle ke saath iska texture badalta rehta hai.

def.en: The release of a mature egg from an ovary, triggered by a surge of LH, roughly two weeks before the next period.
def.hg: Ovary se mature egg ka release hona, jo LH ke surge se hota hai, agle period se kareeb do hafte pehle.

def.en: Physical and emotional changes such as bloating, tender breasts and irritability in the one to two weeks before a period.
def.hg: Period se ek-do hafte pehle hone wale physical aur emotional changes, jaise bloating, breasts mein tenderness aur chidchidapan.

def.en: A severe, treatable condition in which intense mood symptoms appear before periods and disrupt daily life, then lift after bleeding starts.
def.hg: Ek severe par treatable condition, jisme period se pehle intense mood symptoms daily life disturb kar dete hain aur bleeding start hone par hat jaate hain.

def.en: A common hormonal condition with irregular ovulation, irregular periods and signs of higher androgens, such as extra facial hair and acne.
def.hg: Ek common hormonal condition, jisme ovulation aur periods irregular hote hain aur androgens badhne ke signs dikhte hain, jaise face pe extra baal aur acne.

def.en: A condition in which tissue similar to the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, causing inflammation and often severe pain.
def.hg: Aisi condition jisme uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar grow karta hai, jisse inflammation aur aksar severe pain hota hai.

def.en: A rare but serious infection linked to tampons or cups left in too long; signs are sudden high fever, rash, vomiting and dizziness.
def.hg: Ek rare par serious infection, jo bahut der tak lage rahe tampon ya cup se juda hai; signs hain achanak tez bukhaar, rash, ulti aur chakkar.
